title: investigation_job
description: An asynchronous investigation (body of GET /investigations/{id}). Lifecycle QUEUED -> RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED | FAILED. Once terminal, status, steps, result, explanation, clarification and failure never change. State rules enforced below: QUEUED has no steps and no outcome; RUNNING has no outcome; SUCCEEDED has a result and/or a clarification and no failure; FAILED has a failure and no result. Semantic rules (byb_contracts.validate_investigation_job): steps are numbered 1..n in order; a terminal job has no RUNNING step; every evidence_id cited by a step or an explanation statement exists in result.evidence; a MODEL_VALIDATED statement cites at least one evidence record; result.policy_version == policy_version.

deadline_at.description: If the job is not terminal by this time it is marked FAILED with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. Clients stop polling shortly after it.

expires_at.description: After this time the job may be deleted and GET returns 410.

policy_version.description: The confirmed policy version this job evaluates. Fixed at creation.

request.description: Exactly what was submitted and validated before the worker was invoked.

resolved_request.description: The structured request actually evaluated. Equal to `request` when it was structured; filled by the investigator for a free-text request; null while unresolved.

parent_investigation_id.description: The investigation this one follows (a challenge or an answered clarification).

challenge.description: The CHANGE_RULE challenge that created this job, else null.

mode.description: DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK: the model was unavailable or rejected; the server ran the checks itself and every statement is a template.

steps.description: Real tool events only, in execution order. Never model reasoning.

clarification.description: A targeted question the user must answer before a (further) check makes sense.

result.description: The server-enforced engine result. The model cannot alter it.

retryable.description: True when submitting a new investigation (new idempotency key) may succeed.

proposed_corrections.description: Unverified user corrections raised against this investigation's evidence. Appending here never changes result or evidence.

portfolio.description: OPTIONAL member. The exact fictional portfolio this job is checked against, fixed at creation: the persona's scenario portfolio, or the customized portfolio sent with the request. A CHANGE_RULE child job carries its parent's. Absent only on jobs stored before this member existed; those were checked against the scenario portfolio.

initiated_by.description: MODEL: the investigator chose this call. SERVER: run by the service whatever the model did (mandatory checks).

input_summary.description: Template-rendered summary of the validated tool input.

result_summary.description: Template-rendered summary of the tool output; null while RUNNING.

rendered_by.description: TEMPLATE: deterministic text. MODEL_VALIDATED: model-written and accepted only because each claim cites evidence records of the right metric, subject, unit and period.
